parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for the single-protein target Hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Return columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures, INNER JOIN required, exclude nulls), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi; exclude nulls), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Filter activities on standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Join path: target_dictionary (chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717') -> assays on tid -> activities on assay_id -> molecule_dictionary on molregno -> compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN) -> compound_records on activities.record_id -> docs on activities.doc_id. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
